title: Anthropic Secret API key: one-property twin (prefix) (unresolved)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: sk-ant-admin01- (Admin API key) vs contracted sk-ant-api03- and prefix namespace: sk-ant-api01- (Compliance Access Key) vs contracted sk-ant-api03-. Twin of "Anthropic Secret API key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. The outcome shows how the changed property is treated.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T0: the evidence is unresolved and the fixtures were unscored, so no outcome is asserted. Not asserted: disputed property — whether sk-ant-api01- and sk-ant-admin01- are Anthropic credentials of the shared type (they are, per the provider pages and redact-secret#862; the twins predate that and assert the opposite). No provider-owned source decides it and the research pass recorded it as searched-and-not-found, so the benchmark stops asserting it (docs/decisions/2026-09-24-stop-asserting-provider-undecided-format-properties.md). Kept as history; the product's behaviour on this property is unmeasured for anthropic-token.
